decision.accepted: same-session exact append of a complete committed prefix
rejected: fallback to fresh generation for a missing or mismatched session
decision.reason: Qwen3.5 uses 18 non-trimmable Gated DeltaNet ArraysCache instances plus 6 KVCache instances; its recurrent state has no safe rollback or branch contract in the pinned API

covered: complete generated output is part of the next committed prefix
only the appended suffix is evaluated
changed or missing old tokens are rejected before mutation
strategy or model binding mismatch is rejected
failure after partial cache mutation invalidates the session
duplicate request IDs and duplicate JSON keys fail closed

real_two_turn_smoke.performance_interpretation: correctness and candidate timing only; the host had high background CPU load and existing system swap, so no speedup is claimed

post_real_smoke_changes.reason_not_rerun: The parent task explicitly stopped additional model launches after the successful smoke.
post_real_smoke_changes.model_path_equivalence: The current service delegates cache construction to mlx_lm.models.cache.make_prompt_cache; for the pinned Qwen3.5 model that frozen function calls the same model.make_cache method exercised by the real smoke.
non_model_hardening: resident reset integrity failures now invalidate before returning an error
the Rust boundary rejects unknown evictions and session-count divergence
the Rust boundary terminates on any unexpected session worker error
the direct ordinary-generate API terminates on worker codes outside generation_failed and invalid_model
all termination paths sweep the owned worker process group before leader reap

local_cli_exposure_after_smoke.reason_not_rerun: The next slice was explicitly restricted to fake workers and frozen real-service evidence.
service_changes: retain and expose the already Rust-validated ready receipt
return the already Rust-validated reset receipt to the outer application layer
keep only generation_failed, invalid_model, session_cache_failed, and session_cache_limit session errors recoverable after invalidating the affected session
abort immediately on malformed outer input without waiting for the configurable worker timeout
sweep the original worker process group before reaping its leader, including after a valid graceful acknowledgement

limitations: the 512 MiB bound covers live logical session-cache nbytes, not allocator reservations or process RSS
sessions are serial, process-local, and lost on shutdown or worker failure
Qwen3.5 recurrent cache is mutated in place, so failed appends invalidate instead of rolling back
no formal noisy-host throughput or TTFT speedup claim
the local CLI is not an HTTP, OpenAI-compatible, or SSE endpoint
